"-- ============================================================================
-- OIDC IDENTITY LINKING MIGRATION
-- Enhances public.users to automatically sync with Supabase auth.users
-- ============================================================================

-- Ensure public.users.id explicitly references auth.users(id)
ALTER TABLE public.users 
  DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS users_id_fkey;

ALTER TABLE public.users
  ADD CONSTRAINT users_id_fkey 
  FOREIGN KEY (id) 
  REFERENCES auth.users(id) 
  ON DELETE CASCADE;

-- Create the trigger function to handle OIDC / Auth signups
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
  -- Insert into public.users, extracting metadata provided by OIDC providers (Google, Apple, etc.)
  INSERT INTO public.users (id, email, first_name, last_name, role)
  VALUES (
    NEW.id,
    NEW.email,
    -- Extract first name from various common OIDC claims
    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'first_name', NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'given_name', split_part(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'name', ' ', 1), 'Unknown'),
    -- Extract last name from various common OIDC claims
    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'last_name', NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'family_name', split_part(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'name', ' ', 2), 'Unknown'),
    -- Assign default role, allow passing in metadata if needed
    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'role', 'PARENT')
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
    email = EXCLUDED.email,
    -- Only update names if they are 'Unknown' to avoid overwriting user edits
    first_name = CASE WHEN public.users.first_name = 'Unknown' THEN EXCLUDED.first_name ELSE public.users.first_name END,
    last_name = CASE WHEN public.users.last_name = 'Unknown' THEN EXCLUDED.last_name ELSE public.users.last_name END;
  
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

-- Attach the trigger to auth.users
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS on_auth_user_created ON auth.users;
CREATE TRIGGE
